discussion.body: Single ending. Thesis always: Nyxara is sealed under a rebound of the six aspects; the World Cannon is spiked as a plug, not fired as a gun; Asteria remains, scarred. There is no Nyxara-wins cinematic, no mist-world cinematic, no Cannon-utopia cinematic. Allowed variations, few: (1) Bengenia standing or wiped. (2) Which main-side graves exist. (3) Velith dead, shackled, or vanished in the wipe. (4) Vortan dead or shackled in Constium. (5) Final fight texture from clean vs cracked Sigils. (6) Presence or absence of personal epilogue lines for living main-side characters. Romance beat for Cael and Liraen is always available because they cannot die. Getting to the ending changes. The ending does not.
